title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Everything about bookings, payment and masters — on one page.
metaDescription: Answers to common questions about booking a master, payments, verification, cancellations and how UstoGo works.
noResultsDesc: Try another word, or write to us directly.
stillDesc: Write to us — we reply within one working day.
q1: How do I book a master?
a1: Pick your category and city in search, find a master who fits, and press Book. Give the date, time and address and describe the job — the master sees the request and either accepts or declines it.
q2: Can I move a booking to another time?
a2: Yes, once. A booking can be rescheduled up to 24 hours before it starts and only while the master has not begun work. After that the only option left is to cancel.
a3: Cancelling is free, but doing it less than 3 hours before the scheduled time is recorded as a late cancellation. It stays on your account history and masters can see it.
a4: UstoGo handles no money. You pay the master directly once the job is done — in cash or by transfer. In the app you only record what you paid, so your spending history stays accurate.
q5: Is the price on a master profile final?
a5: No, it is a starting price. The final figure depends on the scope: the master sends an exact quote after seeing your description or the site itself. Nothing is fixed until you accept it.
q6: Do I get any document after the work?
a6: Yes. Every completed booking produces a completion certificate with a unique verification code. Anyone can check it on the UstoGo verification page — it is proof the work really went through the platform.
a7: Every applicant confirms their email address and fills in their personal details, work categories and portfolio. A UstoGo moderator then reviews the application by hand, and the profile only appears in search once it is approved.
q8: How do I become a master myself?
a8: Fill in the form on the master registration page, add your categories and services, and upload photos of finished work. The more complete the application, the faster it clears review.
q9: How does the UstoGo shop work?
a9: The shop carries materials and tools from our retail partners. Add a product to your cart and place the order — the seller contacts you. Payment is settled directly with the seller as well.
q10: Where do I collect my order?
a10: The Shops page has a map of every retail point. Press "Near me" and the list sorts itself by distance, with directions you can open on a map.
